notes.title: Affiliate Program
notes.content:
Sports Mogul, Inc. has recently created an affiliate program and is now accepting applicants that would like to earn another form of income. Profit margins range from 20-40% (depending upon a few factors). If you have a sizable following, this could be a great way to bring in some extra money.

If you're interested, be sure to e-mail connor@sportsmogul.com for more information.

Thanks!
